name: Horn
description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage. If the creature moved at least 20 feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) piercing damage.
